calibration_population.membership_rule: First 20 lexicographically sorted image files under REF-A1, REF-A10 and REF-A11; the scored REF-A9 file and W1-24 close-up are excluded.
calibration_population.ours_membership: Twenty non-scored renderer thumbnails must be regenerated by the independent calibration administrator; none of the W1-24 scored files may enter.
calibration_population.actor_constraint: Fresh calibration actor must not score Protocol B. Builder does not answer either calibration question.

stopping_rule: After undegraded control >=16/20 and tell audit passes, seal the first candidate with fidelity identification <=13/20 and subject/silhouette nameability >=16/20. If none qualifies, stop red before scored judging.
reason_unselected: Selection requires a disjoint human calibration actor. No scored key or scored answer was opened or produced by the builder.
